exposure: Mode of delivery (elective Cesarean, vaginal, emergent Cesarean)
outcome: Critical hemorrhage requiring massive red blood cell transfusion
cohort: This nationwide study in Japan included 354,299 women who gave birth between 2018 and 2022.
finding: Prenatal history of hypertension was significantly associated with the development of HELLP syndrome, eclampsia, and critical obstetric hemorrhage.
